title: The First Blood
summary: Ha-Jun's blood awakens the dormant Mythic Relic. As Kuro's feather bonds to his flesh, his right arm mutates into a crystalline demonic gauntlet and the Sovereign System awakens—drawing the first Lesser Imp through a spatial tear on the rooftop.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's trembling pale hand clutching Kuro's obsidian feather, fresh scarlet blood dripping from his punctured palm onto the glossy black plumage.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's trembling pale hand clutching Kuro's obsidian feather, fresh scarlet blood dripping from his punctured palm onto the glossy black plumage.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka kaanpta hua peela haath Kuro ke obsidian pankh ko pakad raha tha, uski zakhmi hatheli se chamakdar kale pankhon par taaza laal khoon tapak raha tha.

panels.action: The instant human blood touches the feather's quill, vibrant neon-violet and crimson magical flames burst to life without producing any smoke.
panels.prose_en: The instant human blood touches the feather's quill, vibrant neon-violet and crimson magical flames burst to life without producing any smoke.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi insani khoon pankh ki nok ko chhuta hai, chamakte hue neon-violet aur lal rang ki jaadui laptein bina koi dhuan paida kiye dahak uthi.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes snapping wide in disbelief, radiant violet fire reflecting in his wide dark pupils.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh aag...?! Yeh jal nahi rahi...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes snapping wide in disbelief, radiant violet fire reflecting in his wide dark pupils.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen hairat aur khauf se phail gayi thi, uski kaali putliyon mein chamakti baingani aag jhalak rahi thi.

panels.action: The solid feather liquefies into ethereal violet-black plasma, wrapping like living molten silk around Ha-Jun's bleeding fingers.
panels.prose_en: The solid feather liquefies into ethereal violet-black plasma, wrapping like living molten silk around Ha-Jun's bleeding fingers.
panels.prose_hi: Wo shaitani pankh shaitani baingani-kaale plasma mein pighal jata hai, Ha-Jun ki khoon bah rahi ungaliyon ke charon or pighle hue resham ki tarah lipatne lagta hai.

panels.action: A glowing violet tendril of liquid mana sinks directly into the open cut on Ha-Jun's palm, entering his bloodstream.

dialogue.text: Pehle hi sparsh mein... sadiyon ka bandhan jud gaya.

panels.prose_en: A glowing violet tendril of liquid mana sinks directly into the open cut on Ha-Jun's palm, entering his bloodstream.
panels.prose_hi: Baingani mana roshni ki ek chamakti baingani tendril Ha-Jun ki hatheli par khule zakhm mein seedhe dhasne lagti hai, aur uske khoon ki ragon mein ragon mein utarne lagti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun shouting in panic, violently shaking his right arm to fling the feather off, but the black-violet plasma clings stubbornly to his skin.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shouting in panic, violently shaking his right arm to fling the feather off, but the black-violet plasma clings stubbornly to his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ghabrahat mein chilla raha hai, pankh ko girane ke liye apne dahine haath ko jor se hila raha hai, lekin kala-bangni plasma uski tvacha se majbuti se chipak gaya hai.

panels.action: A violent 360-degree radial blast wave of violet mana erupts from his hand, blasting falling rain droplets outward in a circular ring.
panels.prose_en: A violent 360-degree radial blast wave of violet mana erupts from his hand, blasting falling rain droplets outward in a circular ring.
panels.prose_hi: Uske haath se baingani man ki ek hinsak 360-degri radial blast lahar nikalti hai, jo ek golakar ring mein girti hui baarish ki boondon ko bahar ki or udati hai.

panels.action: Distant panoramic view of the metropolis at night: Above Saint Mirren University, a brief vertical pillar of invisible demonic energy pierces the storm clouds.

dialogue.text: Ek aisi taqat jo sadiyon se so rahi thi... achanak jaag uthi.

panels.prose_en: Distant panoramic view of the metropolis at night: Above Saint Mirren University, a brief vertical pillar of invisible demonic energy pierces the storm clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Rat mein mahanagar ka door ka vihangam drishya: sent miren vishwavidyalaya ke upar, adrishya demonic mana ka ek sankshipt udhrvadhar stambh toofani baadalon ko cheer deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun crashes back onto his knees on the wet rooftop, clutching his right forearm as thick violet veins bulge visibly under his pale skin.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: AHHH...!! MERA HAATH... JAL RAHA HAI!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun crashes back onto his knees on the wet rooftop, clutching his right forearm as thick violet veins bulge visibly under his pale skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun gili chhat par apne ghutnon ke bal baith jata hai aur apni dahini baamh pakad leta hai kyonki uski pili tvacha ke neeche moti baingani nasen ubhari hui dikhai deti han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun gritting his teeth so violently that a bead of blood trickles from his split lip, neck tendons taut with agonizing pressure.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gritting his teeth so violently that a bead of blood trickles from his split lip, neck tendons taut with agonizing pressure.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne daanton ko itni tivrata se piece raha hai ki uske kate hue honth se khoon ki ek boond tapak rahi hai, gardan ki condraen pidadayak dabav se tani hui han.

panels.action: Sharp, jagged purple-black crystalline plates click into existence over his knuckles and fingers, encasing his hand in demonic armor.
panels.prose_en: Sharp, jagged purple-black crystalline plates click into existence over his knuckles and fingers, encasing his hand in demonic armor.
panels.prose_hi: Tej, dantedar bangni-kali crystaliy pleten uske por aur ungaliyon par astitva mein aa jaati han, jo uske haath ko shaitani demonic kavach ​​men dhak deti han.

panels.action: White restorative steam hisses from Ha-Jun's cheek and forearm. The bullies' deep bruises and cuts seal and vanish in seconds.
panels.prose_en: White restorative steam hisses from Ha-Jun's cheek and forearm. The bullies' deep bruises and cuts seal and vanish in seconds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke gaal aur baanh se safed punarsthapnatmak bhaap fusfusati hai. badmashon ki gahri choten aur cut seal ho jaate hain aur kuch hi second mein gayab ho jaate han.

panels.action: Stylized internal vision: Deep inside Ha-Jun's chest, an ancient obsidian seal fractures, releasing a glowing violet core of Demon Sovereign power.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki thi.

panels.prose_en: Stylized internal vision: Deep inside Ha-Jun's chest, an ancient obsidian seal fractures, releasing a glowing violet core of Demon Sovereign power.
panels.prose_hi: Shailigat aantarik drishti: Ha-Jun ki chhati ke andar gahrai men, ek prachin obsidian seal toot gai hai, jo danav samprabhu shakti ka ek chamakta hua baingani core jaari kar rahi hai.

panels.action: Full reveal of Ha-Jun's right arm: Transformed into a majestic, crystalline purple and black Demonic Gauntlet with pulsing neon-violet mana circuits.
panels.prose_en: Full reveal of Ha-Jun's right arm: Transformed into a majestic, crystalline purple and black Demonic Gauntlet with pulsing neon-violet mana circuits.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke dahine haath ka pura khulasa: spandit nion-violet maina circuit ke saath ek rajsi, crystaliy baingani aur kale shaitani demonic gauntlet mein parivertit.

panels.action: Ha-Jun panting heavily, one demonic gauntleted hand pressed onto the cracked wet concrete floor, rain beating against his shoulders.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun panting heavily, one demonic gauntleted hand pressed onto the cracked wet concrete floor, rain beating against his shoulders.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jor-jor se hanf raha tha, ek shaitani demonic tang haath toote hue gile concrete ke farsh par daba hua tha, baarish uske kandhon par pad rahi thi.

panels.action: Extreme close-up: Ha-Jun raises his head. His dark brown pupil has transformed into a glowing, slit-pupil demonic violet ring.
panels.prose_en: Extreme close-up: Ha-Jun raises his head. His dark brown pupil has transformed into a glowing, slit-pupil demonic violet ring.
panels.prose_hi: Atyadhik clos-up: Ha-Jun apna sir uthata hai. uski gahri bhuri putli ek chamkati, bhatthi-putli shaitani demonic baingani anguthi mein badal gai hai.

panels.action: Perception slows down: Falling raindrops appear suspended like glass beads in mid-air around Ha-Jun as supernatural sensory acceleration kicks in.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sab kuch... itna dheere kyun ho gaya?

panels.prose_en: Perception slows down: Falling raindrops appear suspended like glass beads in mid-air around Ha-Jun as supernatural sensory acceleration kicks in.
panels.prose_hi: Dharna dhimi ho jaati hai: alaukik sanvedi tvaran shuru hone par Ha-Jun ke aaspaas girti hui baarish ki bunden madhya hawa mein kaanch ke motiyon ki tarah latki hui dikhai deti han.

panels.action: Geometric obsidian holographic shards fracture into existence in the air directly in front of Ha-Jun's face.
panels.prose_en: Geometric obsidian holographic shards fracture into existence in the air directly in front of Ha-Jun's face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke chehre ke theek samne hawa mein jyamitiya obsidian holographic tukde astitva mein aa gaye.

panels.action: A floating dark-glass system window appears glowing with crisp violet typography: [ALERT: DEMON SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE DETECTED].
panels.prose_en: A floating dark-glass system window appears glowing with crisp violet typography: [ALERT: DEMON SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE DETECTED].
panels.prose_hi: Ek floating dark-glas system window kurkura baingani typography ke saath chamakti hui dikhai deti hai: [chetavni: danav samprabhu raktarekha ka pata chala].

panels.action: Ha-Jun staring with wide, bewildered eyes at the hovering system window, rain droplets sliding down his cheeks.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh... koi video game ki screen hai kya?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun staring with wide, bewildered eyes at the hovering system window, rain droplets sliding down his cheeks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chaudi, hatprabh aankhon se mandrati hui system window ko dekh raha hai, baarish ki boondein uske gaalon se fisal rahi han.

panels.action: Close-up on system screen: [SYNCHRONIZATION: 1.2%] | [RELIC 1/10: KURO'S FALLEN FEATHER (MYTHIC) BOUND].
panels.prose_en: Close-up on system screen: [SYNCHRONIZATION: 1.2%] | [RELIC 1/10: KURO'S FALLEN FEATHER (MYTHIC) BOUND].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm screen par clos-up: [sinkranization: 1.2%] | [avshesh 1/10: Kuro ka gira hua pankh (pauranik) bandha hua].

panels.action: System screen flashes dark crimson text: [WARNING: THE SOVEREIGN'S SCENT WILL ATTRACT PREDATORS OF THE ABYSS].
panels.prose_en: System screen flashes dark crimson text: [WARNING: THE SOVEREIGN'S SCENT WILL ATTRACT PREDATORS OF THE ABYSS].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm screen par gahre lal rang ka text chamakta hai: [chetavni: Sovereign ki khushboo rasatal ke shikariyon ko aakarshit karegi].

panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches his crystalline demonic gauntlet forward to touch the screen, sending violet circular ripples across the holographic glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches his crystalline demonic gauntlet forward to touch the screen, sending violet circular ripples across the holographic glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun screen ko chhune ke liye apne crystaliy shaitani demonic kavach ​​ki or badhta hai, aur holographic glass par baingani rang ki golakar tarangen bhejta hai.

panels.action: The system window suddenly turns bright neon red, alarms pulsing: [CRITICAL: SPATIAL FRACTURE 10 METERS BEHIND YOU].
panels.prose_en: The system window suddenly turns bright neon red, alarms pulsing: [CRITICAL: SPATIAL FRACTURE 10 METERS BEHIND YOU].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm window achanak chamakdar nean lal ho jaati hai, alarm bajne lagta hai: [gambhir: aapke peeche 10 meter sthanik fractur].

panels.action: Across the wet rooftop terrace, space tears open like black cracked glass with violent purple lightning arcs dancing around the breach.
panels.prose_en: Across the wet rooftop terrace, space tears open like black cracked glass with violent purple lightning arcs dancing around the breach.
panels.prose_hi: Geeli chhat ke par, antriksh ke aansu kale toote hue kaanch ki tarah khulte hain aur daraar ke charon or hinsak baingani bijli ki chaap naach rahi hai.

panels.action: Thick, corrosive pitch-black demon fog pours out of the dimensional tear, hissing as it melts the wet concrete rooftop tiles.
panels.prose_en: Thick, corrosive pitch-black demon fog pours out of the dimensional tear, hissing as it melts the wet concrete rooftop tiles.
panels.prose_hi: Ghna, sanksharak pich-kala danav kohra aayami aansu se bahar nikalta hai, jo gili concrete ki chhat ki tailon ko pighlata hai.

panels.action: From the swirling black miasma, multiple pairs of glowing sulfur-yellow multifaceted predator eyes glare out with feral hunger.
panels.prose_en: From the swirling black miasma, multiple pairs of glowing sulfur-yellow multifaceted predator eyes glare out with feral hunger.
panels.prose_hi: Ghumte hue kale miyazma se, chamakti gandhak-pili bahuaayami shikari aankhon ke kai jode junglee bhookh se chamakte han.

panels.action: An 8-foot tall Lesser Imp demon steps onto Earth: Leathery gargoyle wings, razor-sharp scythe forearms, and a maw dripping caustic black venom.
panels.prose_en: An 8-foot tall Lesser Imp demon steps onto Earth: Leathery gargoyle wings, razor-sharp scythe forearms, and a maw dripping caustic black venom.
panels.prose_hi: Ek 8 foot lamba lesar imp danav prithvi par kadam rakhta hai: chamde ke gargoil pankh, ustra-nukile talwar wale agrabahu, aur ek jabde se teekha kala jahar tapakta hai.

panels.action: The beast inhales the rain-soaked air, locking its glowing eyes directly onto Ha-Jun's glowing gauntlet with sadistic ravenous glee.
panels.prose_en: The beast inhales the rain-soaked air, locking its glowing eyes directly onto Ha-Jun's glowing gauntlet with sadistic ravenous glee.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar baarish se bheegi hui hawa mein sans leta hai, aur apni chamakti aankhon ko sidhe Ha-Jun ke parpidk ullas ke saath chamakte dastaane par band kar deta hai.

panels.action: Grand cliffhanger: 17yo Ha-Jun turns to face the towering demon beast, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with brilliant violet mana in the pouring storm.
panels.prose_en: 17-year-old Ha-Jun turns to face the towering demon beast, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with brilliant violet mana in the pouring storm.
panels.prose_hi: Satra saal ka Ha-Jun vishal rakshas janwar ka samna karne ke liye mudta hai, uska crystaliy baingani gauntlet tez toofan mein shandar baingani maina ke saath chamak raha hai.
